newsitem.title: ITALY: Bulgari H1 '97 net sales up 27 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgari H1 '97 net sales up 27 pct.

text.p: Italian luxury goods group Bulgari said preliminary data for the first half of 1997 showed its net sales had rise 27 percent over the same period in 1996, to reach 237 billion lire.
"We are particularly satisfied with the results achieved in the first half of the year," managing director Francesco Trapani said in a statement.
"These confirm and support our willingness to continue the intense activity of launching new products and expanding the distribution network," Trapani said.
He said the group expected to continue its strategic plan into the second half of the year when it would introduce new lines, open five new shops and reopen its renovated shop in New York.
Bulgari said it had recently signed a letter of intent with the ONG group to buy three shops in London, currently franchises, with sales of more than 17 billion lire in 1996.
The group noted that at a constant rate of exchange the rise in net sales was 33 percent on the same period last year.
